name: Pre-integrated Volume Rendering with Dependent Texture Lookups
aliases: Dependent Texture Mapping for Volume Rendering
definition: A hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique that uses dependent texture lookups to perform pre-integrated color and opacity blending along viewing rays, replacing slice-by-slice compositing with slab-by-slab rendering using two adjacent slices.
summary: Pre-integrated Volume Rendering with Dependent Texture Lookups is a hardware-accelerated technique that uses 2D dependent textures to store pre-integrated color and opacity values for ray segments, enabling high-quality lighting without polygon extraction.
